evals.name: ux-guidelines-casual
evals.prompt: can you audit https://www.ux-guidelines.com/ for me? want to know whats wrong with it ux/ui wise, be thorough but keep the writeup short
evals.expected_output: Short severity-ranked audit with measured evidence across a11y, usability, visual, motion, content, performance

evals.name: candor-local-mobile-motion
evals.prompt: do a UX/UI audit of the landing page i have running locally at http://127.0.0.1:8765/ — it's a B Corp consultancy site. mobile matters most and i care a lot about the animations/motion
evals.expected_output: Mobile-first audit with a substantive motion section (works / problems / opportunities with timing numbers) and reduced-motion + no-JS findings

evals.name: hci-textbook-pre-recommend
evals.prompt: Before I recommend https://introductiontohci.org/ to my students, can you check whether the site itself is accessible and easy to use? Short answer please.
evals.expected_output: Very short verdict-led audit focused on accessibility and usability with evidence
